description:
Guests will enjoy the most exclusive comedy show in NYC. No where else in the city can you find the community of diverse comics and connection that we provide every Monday night.

You'll start by entering the club where I'll greet you at the host stand. Upon check in, grab your free drink at the bar and take in the history around you. From there I'll lead you into the showroom or you can hang in the bar area hoping to see a famous comic before the show begins.

By the end of our show, the entire audience feels like a unified community with the inside jokes and personalized story telling from our seasoned team of comedians. You can't get this experience anywhere else in NYC!
hostdescription: Hi, my name is Kevin Hurley! I am a NYC-based comic of 10+ years and my passion is bringing laughter into the world. I am the co-founder of the comedy collective Comedy Mob, as well as the Director of New Talent at Stand Up NY.
locationDescription: This is a historic comedy club dating back to 1986. When you walk into the club, you'll notice the photos of famous comics lining the walls. Every inch of the club seems to tell a story.

reviews.text: Really fun experience that I wouldn’t have found in town on my own! The $5 covers a drink at the venue. All the comedians we saw were funny and varied in experience and styles. They each did a set of 4 mins so you get a broad array of performances. The venue was cozy, everyone is close to the stage, and it wasn’t too packed when we were there. Highly recommend if you’re looking for something to do on a Monday night.

It was a mixed bag of comedians, and I'm sure there are better nights than the one I went to. The Mondays are for trying out new material, which sometimes works and sometimes... not so much. The venue is cute and authentic, the staff is nice, and I didn't feel pressured into buying more drinks than the one that came with the ticket, even though the door said $18 minimum order. Even if I didn't get to laugh very hard, it was still a nice way to support local talent.

Very typical place of a stand-up but it was excellent.
Very dynamic, rhythmed, it's a good value for money and you can't see the time spent!
I recommend it 100%.

Super fun experience! All the comedians had something special to offer and the service was quick and efficient. Enjoyed all the laughs and you can’t beat the price. I would definitely go back the next time I’m in town!
I was skeptical when i booked the experience but the whole venue surpassed my expectations. Great welcoming, great comedians, and great bar. I would definitely do it again if i go back to new york.

Me and my girlfriend had an amazing time at this event. We came into the location, Kevin welcomed us with a free drink voucher and showed us our seats (which were great btw) the location it’s just a vibe itself and I would encourage everyone to book this event. The comics were awesome too, I can’t remember a place were I laughed this much. And to everyone who is curios, there is no catch to this event. Kevin is just doing what he loves and wants to show other people the NYC Stand - Up Comedy scene.
Kevin is a great guy, and he made us feel very welcome. It was so much fun. This is the perfect incredibly cheap night out if you want laughs and a drink.
This experience exceeded my expectations. The comics were great, I laughed all the time. I'd be going there every other week if I lived in NY.
great spot close to the subway, lots of personal touches and toiletries, tampons, pads, shampoo etc. Kevin was super responsive and checked us in early!

My friends and I had a great time, even though we were late Kevin still accommodated us and had no problem with the bar or the drinks. The comedians were very funny. If we’re ever in nyc again we’ll definitely be visiting
The show was amazing from start to finish! We loved every second! Great night out in New York! This was one of our favourite things to do in NY while visiting. Thanks!
My date and I booked this as a spur of the moment decision. It was a great show and she loved it! I recommend checking it out if you’re in the area
This place is a blast, the areas great, the comics are hilarious, and everyones welcoming and cool. 100% would recommend to anyone nearby

We had such a fun night at the comedy club! Our seats were good, the free drinks were great, the not-free drinks were reasonable, service was excellent and the comedians were much better than we thought they’d be. We’d do it again in a heartbeat!

What a wonderful experience!! The club is in a great location and very clean! Kevin is great! He clearly loves what he’s doing and it shows! The comedians were super talented and funny! I truly can’t say enough good things about our experience!
The experience was super fun! Kevin was very friendly and we even got a surprise visit from TJ Miller. Super great experience (especially for the price)!

This was so good . Anyone visiting from the UK must go!
It’s easy to find , everyone was SO friendly , the comedy was superb and being part of the audience as upcoming future stars hone their craft , was a fabulous treat.
Added onto the fact that you get a complimentary drink , you would be mad to miss this.
Kevin was great, expecting us and hosting a truly memorable evening .

Great stand up show, I'm sure in the future we'll hear about some of the comedians who performed that evening.

It was so fun!! I went with my boyfriend and we enjoyed it so much. A lot of great comedians there. We will come again soon!
There is also a free drink included which was nice and the other drinks were cheap too! Kevin, the host, was super nice and welcomed us!

This is a brilliant thing to be a part of. You get such a unique experience that I’m pretty sure I may not come across in any other travels that I’ve either done or May do in the future. It’s well worth doing, and it’s a bargain
Kevin is an outstanding host! It was a very easy location, he greeted us and made us feel welcome right from the start, and the atmosphere was so welcoming with everyone just meshing together.

We had a fun night. Kevin was responsive and very personable. There were way more comedians than expected, mostly amateurs honing their skills, but several were really good.

Fantastic evening! Didn't expect so many guys on stage 😲 My favourite one was the guy half Pakistan and Kevin of course. A lot of different comedians! Highly recommended!

Kevin was a great host, and greeted us as soon as we arrived, which put us at ease.

The format was fun - lots and lots of acts doing about 5 minutes each. A lot of newbies and a few trying out new material.

Kevin was chatty at the end and even offered us some hints and tips in the city.

Great stand ups and great drinks.

Lowkey favorite bari visited during my week here. Plenty of other good drinks as well for non-alcoholics.

We had such a fun time at this show! We were welcomed with our complimentary drinks and got to watch some great comics. They tested out their material in short sets and I can bet there is a comic there who will match any sense of humor. I also really enjoyed the camaraderie amongst the comics, it kept the mood light and positive. Awesome group- would definitely recommend to friends in NYC on a Monday!
This an absolute blast!! Kevin was a great host and everyone was very kind and pretty dang funny!! Don’t hesitate to book, it’s a great time and we were treated like family

The show was SO fun! it was the first time going to event like this alone and I felt comfortable the whole time and entertained because there were aoany comedians performing back to back. Very welcoming hosts and barternders as well. had a great time AND on a Monday night.
